title: Prior image
responsibility: Shows an earlier committed design image without annotation controls.

inputs.name: PriorImage.workspace
inputs.description: Workspace used by imageUrl to resolve the earlier image URL. It is required and passed through without inspection by this component.

inputs.name: PriorImage.entityId
inputs.description: Entity identifier passed to imageUrl with the version and digest. This component treats it as an opaque string and does not parse or validate it.

inputs.name: PriorImage.version
inputs.description: Version string passed to imageUrl and rendered in the Before · {version} caption. This component does not parse it or choose which version is earlier.

inputs.name: PriorImage.sha256
inputs.description: SHA-256 digest passed to imageUrl with the entity identifier and version. This component does not calculate or validate the digest.

inputs.name: PriorImage.title
inputs.description: Title used as the image alt text when the resolved URL is non-empty. It is not shown in the fallback message.

inputs.name: PriorImage.caption
inputs.description: Text of the comparison caption. Defaults to the historical version label.

inputs.name: PriorImage.note
inputs.description: Text shown when no before capture exists. Defaults to an empty string.

outputs.name: PriorImage
outputs.description: Renders a figure with a Before · {version} caption. It shows the resolved image with title as alt text when the URL is truthy, otherwise shows Loading earlier image…; the component has no annotation controls.
